H2_calibration.quote: A general federal false-statements law might apply to false certifications.
H2_calibration.note: also: Whether the general federal savings statute (1 U.S.C. § 109) covers an expiring statute is contested.

H4_grandfather_step.quote: Exempting any system "whose training began" before enactment invites companies to start large runs before the bill becomes law. "Began" is undefined, so even a token start might qualify.
